grammar.title: Present Continuous Tense for Future Events
grammar.explanation: 现在进行时除了表示正在进行的动作，还可以用来表示将来已经计划或安排好的事件，常与时间状语连用。
examples: CIFTIS is coming from September 9 to 13.
The chip release is happening next week.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节，'ch'发音为/k/，元音要清晰。
examples: Advancements in technology are driving growth.
The technology sector is expanding rapidly.

reading.title: China's Tech Advances and Global Cooperation in 2026
reading.content: In 2026, China's technology sector is witnessing remarkable progress. Huawei recently released a high-end chip, marking a significant milestone in semiconductor innovation. This development is expected to enhance China's global competitiveness in tech markets. Concurrently, the China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) is being held in Beijing from September 9 to 13. This year's CIFTIS focuses on global cooperation, particularly in services trade, offering a platform for international partnerships. President Xi Jinping has also highlighted the importance of supporting sci-tech workers, recognizing their vital role in driving innovation. These initiatives underscore China's dedication to technological advancement and its commitment to fostering an open, collaborative environment for global growth.
reading.translation: 2026年，中国科技行业正见证显著进步。华为最近发布了一款高端芯片，标志着半导体创新的重要里程碑。这项进展预计将提升中国在全球科技市场的竞争力。同时，中国国际服务贸易交易会（CIFTIS）于9月9日至13日在北京举行。今年的CIFTIS侧重于全球合作，特别是在服务贸易领域，为国际伙伴关系提供平台。习近平主席也强调了支持科技工作者的重要性，认可他们在推动创新中的关键作用。这些举措突显了中国对技术进步的奉献和对促进开放、协作环境以实现全球增长的承诺。
reading.sourceNote: 基于ChinaDaily新闻素材：High-end chip from Huawei released 和 CIFTIS 2026 unlocks global cooperation opportunities 改写而成。
